headline: Palo Alto Networks in Talks to Acquire Clutch Security for $500M
summary: Cybersecurity giant Palo Alto Networks is in negotiations to acquire Israeli AI agents cybersecurity startup Clutch Security for approximately $500 million.
why: Palo Alto Networks is a major player in enterprise cybersecurity, utilizing acquisitions to expand its capabilities in artificial intelligence security solutions.

impacts.name: Palo Alto Networks
impacts.why: Acquiring a company for $500 million directly impacts corporate capital allocation and expands product portfolios.
